title: Welcome To Valley Desk
message: Track every JKSSB, JKPSC, JK Police, J&K Bank, Judiciary, Teaching, Health & University notification in one place — verified daily.

title: JKSSB MTS & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026
message: JKSSB has opened applications for 2,863 Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts under Advt 09 of 2026. Last date to apply is 03/11/2026.

title: JKSSB Junior Stenographer E-Admit Card Released
message: Admit cards for the Junior Stenographer shorthand skill test are now live for download at NIELIT Jammu/Srinagar centres.

title: JKPSC KAS Prelims Result 2026 Declared
message: JKPSC has declared the KAS Prelims result. Shortlisted candidates can now register for the Mains examination on the official portal.

title: JKSSB Junior Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 Applications Open
message: 216 Junior Pharmacist posts are up for grabs under Advt 08 of 2026 in the Health & Medical Education Department. Applications close 09/10/2026.

title: JKSSB Forest Guard Physical Test Roll Number Out
message: Roll numbers and call letters for the Forest Guard Physical Standard and Endurance Tests are now available for download.
